# Variable `SYSLINUX_SERIAL_TTY`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the alternate console=tty… kernel boot argument. The variable’s default value is set in the syslinux class as follows:

```
SYSLINUX_SERIAL_TTY ?= "console=ttyS0,115200"

```

The class checks for and uses the variable as needed.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SYSLINUX_SERIAL_TTY)
